provenanceSearch.interpretation: This was a directed and non-exhaustive search. No exact match in the reviewed public-web result surface does not prove originality, authorship, clearance or universal absence of a prior source. It did not cover licensed databases, print-only works, deleted pages, translations, private documents, drafts or extensive paraphrase. Candidate factual sources were selected for later claim review; topical relevance or HTTP availability does not verify learner-facing claims, passage identity, authorship or rights.

sourceAvailability.method: Direct HTTPS GET with redirect resolution, a 60-second request cap, response-body SHA-256, content type and byte count. HTTP availability is recorded independently from factual claim review, authorship, licensing and rights verification.
sourceAvailability.interpretation: HTTP availability and response hashes do not establish factual support, authorship, originality, permission, licensing or publication rights. A 200 response is not a claim verdict; 403 and 404 responses are retained honestly as unavailable requested content.

factualResearch.limitation: Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan cadenas cortas, cargas estructurales, requisitos de techos verdes, menor demanda de agua potable y ejemplos educativos, pero no verifican escala, cultivos, clientes, todos los efectos ni la afirmación combinada sobre suelo ligero e irrigación. Disponibilidad no prueba autoría, licencia, hechos ni revisión humana.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes primarias respaldan el aprendizaje, la ayuda de especialistas, reglas de participación, piezas pequeñas y cohesión social, pero no acreditan el origen plural, la práctica universal de permanecer, una comprobación previa sistemática, el requisito eléctrico only ni los grupos y efectos exactos. Copyright y marca no equivalen a licencia para WeLearn.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan tendencias de calor, distinción entre exposición y sensibilidad, combinación satélite/sensores y priorización de sombra, pero no un flujo universal, percepción de longitud, several blocks, mecanismos idénticos para grupos ni beneficios cuantificados. Disponibilidad no prueba autoría, licencia, hechos ni revisión humana.

shortcutReview.interpretation: Prompt-only exact guesses measure answerability from sentence frames without passage evidence; they are not expert adjudications.

studentWalkthrough.limitation: Blind content-only walkthrough; no students, UI or conformance test.

runtime.limitation: Explicit check, immediate post-check key/explanation, client answers, hints and hard-coded limit prevent representation as Practice or Exam simulation.

canonicalAnswerGrammarSurface.caveat: Manual structural classification; it is not a statistical POS certification.

sampleAdequacy.conclusion: n=18 is too small to certify statistically balanced content.

applicability.evidence: Seven learner-facing files and sixteen-file closure remain pinned. UI/Playwright ➖ is not conformity.
